raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_customers stores 60 of 200 regions as numeric codes ('01'-'04'), and silver_customers only applies upper(), so the codes pass through unmapped. raw_region_map supplies the code-to-name mapping (01 WEST, 02 EAST, 03 NORTH, 04 SOUTH), so joining it in silver_customers fixes the domain values and keeps the same output columns.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.75, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(COALESCE(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
